    StartersAtomic Comics popcornPopcorn tossed in butter, grated parmesan and cracked pepperHow to make it2 tbsp coconut oil120g popcorn kernels50g butter, melted40g parmesan, finely grated1 tsp cracked black pepperHeat the oil with 3 kernels, covered, until they pop, then add the rest and shake until the popping slows.Toss with the melted butter, parmesan and cracked pepper.Fill four paper bags.D'Amico's prosciutto melon bitesRockmelon cubes wrapped in prosciutto with basil, balsamic and olive oilHow to make it1/2 rockmelon10 slices of prosciutto20 small basil leaves1 tbsp aged balsamic vinegar1 tbsp olive oil1 tsp cracked black pepperPeel and seed the rockmelon and cut into 20 cubes.Tear the prosciutto in half lengthways.Wrap each cube in prosciutto with a basil leaf tucked inside and spear with a pick.Arrange on a platter, drizzle with balsamic and olive oil and finish with pepper.Bodega bacon, egg and cheese rollsDave's walk to school through New YorkHow to make itAs written, serves 4Soft rolls stuffed with folded fried egg, crisp bacon and melted American cheese, salt, pepper and hot sauce, wrapped in foil like the corner store does it.Fry 8 bacon rashers until crisp.Whisk 6 eggs with salt and pepper and cook as a thin omelette in 20g butter, folding it into 4 squares.Lay 2 slices American cheese on each square to melt.Split and toast 4 soft rolls, add the egg and cheese, then the bacon and a good shake of hot sauce.Wrap each in foil for 2 minutes so everything melts together.MainsBowling alley burgerTwo smashed beef patties with pickles and special sauce, twice-fried chipsHow to make it100g mayonnaise2 tbsp sweet relish1 tsp yellow mustard800g beef mince8 slices of American cheese4 burger buns1 jar dill pickles1kg potatoes2 L vegetable oilMix the mayonnaise, relish and mustard for the sauce. Cut the potatoes into chips.Fry the chips in the vegetable oil at 140°C, then again at 185°C until crisp, and salt.Roll the mince into eight balls and smash thin on a smoking griddle.Top with cheese and stack two per toasted bun with pickles and sauce.Atomic Comics New York pepperoni sliceThe gang's hangout after schoolHow to make itAs written, serves 4Big thin-crust New York slices with garlicky tomato sauce, mozzarella and crisp pepperoni, folded to eat, with chilli flakes, parmesan and hot honey.Mix 500g bread flour, 325ml water, 2g yeast, 10g salt and 1 tbsp oil and refrigerate 24 hours.Divide into 2 balls and rest at room temperature for 2 hours.Heat the oven with a pizza steel at its highest setting for 45 minutes.Stretch each into a 35cm base, spread with 150ml passata mixed with garlic and oregano, top with 200g grated mozzarella and pepperoni.Bake 7 minutes.Cut into big slices and serve with chilli flakes, parmesan and hot honey.SweetsBowling alley ice cream sundaeVanilla and chocolate ice cream with hot fudge, whipped cream, sprinkles and a cherryHow to make it100g dark chocolate400ml thickened cream500ml vanilla ice cream500ml chocolate ice cream2 tbsp sprinkles4 maraschino cherriesMelt the chocolate with some of the cream into a hot fudge.Whip the remaining cream.Layer scoops of both ice creams in four tall glasses with the fudge.Finish with whipped cream, sprinkles and a cherry.DrinksHit-Girl's purple grape ginger fizzGrape and fresh ginger juice with lime and soda over frozen grapes, no alcoholHow to make it200g red grapes1 piece ginger (2 cm)500ml grape juice1 lime250ml soda waterFreeze the grapes.Grate the ginger and squeeze the juice through a sieve into a jug.Add the grape juice and lime juice and stir.Fill small tumblers with the frozen grapes, pour in the mix and top with soda water.
